name: lineage survives a worker thread
why: §5.9 requires propagation into sub-agent work with no further developer code, and a worker thread is where it silently stops: a Python ContextVar is not copied into threading.Thread or ThreadPoolExecutor, and a TypeScript AsyncLocalStorage does not cross into worker_threads. An SDK that loses the binding here still forwards the call, so the traffic looks fine and the record attributes a sub-agent's action to nobody.
